aggregation_rules.distinct_products: Deduplicate canonical product IDs across category memberships; report sightings, products and offerings separately.
aggregation_rules.bounded_coverage: Only compute ratios within an explicitly enumerated, dated source/language/region survey. Label numerator, denominator, exclusions and unresolved identities.
aggregation_rules.breadth: Report categories and subcategories examined plus selected source families, language and regional gaps; not a percentage of all AI.
aggregation_rules.depth: Report sourced, reviewed, independently measured and publication-eligible counts independently. A reviewed record may legitimately retain Unknown claims.
aggregation_rules.freshness: Report current-state claims checked within a declared dated audit and claims needing event-driven recheck; immutable version facts retain their version scope.
aggregation_rules.rights: Report eligibility by source/material/field/intended use, not blanket record-level permission.
aggregation_rules.website_delivery: Published means an immutable admitted artifact has a consumer receipt and actual public readback. A merged research file is not published.
